temporal_state_chain.intention: Comfort Shirley, validate the care they provided, and remind her of the good moments they brought to the patient.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara has observed Shirley remaining reserved and minimally expressive. When Sara confronts her in the office, Shirley says she cannot open up because she does not want to seem unprofessional or weak, though she may try.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley feels responsible and burdened, and she has noticed Shirley withholding emotion, but she does not yet know why Shirley is holding back.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Sara learns that Shirley's reserve is driven by fear of appearing unprofessional or weak.

temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern, empathy, and a gentle sense of urgency
temporal_state_chain.intention: Encourage Shirley to express her emotions, reassure her that doing so is healthy and not a sign of weakness, and offer friendship and support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara apologizes for possibly coming on too strong. Shirley says it was a bit much but acknowledges that Sara meant well, appreciates the apology, and says she wants to keep talking.

temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes their friendship is intact and that Shirley is receptive to continued support and open communication.

temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley has been improving and that her support has been helpful, but she may still want confirmation about how Shirley is really feeling.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Shirley confirms she is feeling better and accepts further social support outside work.
